messages:
Priyanka (Sales): FYI closing note  handoff for Aerolith. Signed MSA today. small pilot then scale. sending initial context.
Leo (CS): nice! can you drop the must-haves and any stickiness / renewal signals?
Priyanka (Sales): Must-haves: dedicated pilot (1 month) in eu-central-1, SAML SSO (Azure AD), VPC peering + private endpoints, and SOC2 logs retention.
Priyanka (Sales): Business context: Aerolith is a regulated energy analytics provider, ARR $180k, cautious on data residency. Target go-live in ~8 weeks.
Priyanka (Sales): Data types: telemetry (non-PII) + customer configs. They expect heavy embeddings use for vector search.
Leo (CS): renewal risk: they said if latency >150ms or cost too high they'll consider competitor. tag RISK=MED-HIGH.
Leo (CS): ownership: Leo = CS lead; Sam = infra/support; Nina = runtime eng.
Sam (Support): opening infra ticket now. need exact node sizing and expected QPS. ETA for provisioning: 4 business days (EU quotas pending).
Nina (Eng): add perf SLOs to ticket pls. what are expected QPS and seq lengths?
Priyanka (Sales): profile: steady 80 QPS, peak 120 QPS, avg sequence length 180 tokens, majority embedding calls ~60%.
Leo (CS): I'll prepare an onboarding runbook and an enablement calendar. Important: they want a 90-min dev workshop 2 weeks after provisioning.
Leo (CS): also collecting Azure AD metadata and the SP-ACS URL; Priyanka can you follow up with their IdP admin?
Priyanka (Sales): pinged IT and PM. they aim to send metadata by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Support): provisional infra checklist I'm adding to ECC ticket:
```
- create dedicated pool (2x V100-equivalent in eu-central-1)
- VPC peering + private DNS entries
- configure private S3/obj storage endpoints
- enable SAML SP and test IdP metadata
- set up TLS cert for staging subdomain
- apply logging retention 90 days (SOC2)
```
Sam (Support): linking this thread into ECC-85271.
Nina (Eng): perf plan: warm KV cache for embeddings, tuned batching for embedding vs gen, and a low-precision fallback for cost spikes. target p50 latency <120ms for gen and <80ms for embeddings.
Nina (Eng): please provide a representative sample of 50 embedding payloads + 30 gen queries for baseline runs.
Leo (CS): I'll ask Aerolith PM for the sample prompt set and a subset of production-like payloads. also will include success metrics they care about.
Priyanka (Sales): they want a cost comparison: pilot vs 6-month production. I attached rough numbers in the CRM; Leo can you produce a clean cost slide for kickoff?
Leo (CS): yep will add cost/ops expectations to kickoff pack.
OpsBot: Channel #inc-6117778889-aerolith-pilot created and oncall rotation notified.
Sam (Support): provisioning window scheduled Fri 07:30 UTC. if EU quota blocks occur we'll escalate to infra-alloc.
Leo (CS): owners + next steps (short):
- Priyanka: deliver IdP metadata + legal notes; confirm data classification
- Sam: ECC-85271 provisioning + network config + timeline
- Nina: perf SLOs + baseline run plan once infra ready
- Leo: onboarding runbook, enablement scheduling, cost slide
Leo (CS): risk log (brief):
- Data residency: HIGH (must deploy EU)
- Latency sensitivity: MED-HIGH (customer will eval against SLOs)
- Renewal signal: NEUTRAL now but could escalate to HIGH if pilot fails
Leo (CS): fallback plan: if initial perf misses SLOs, Nina to propose model variant or routing to a lower-latency region with data guardrails; Sam to enable temporary burst pool for stability tests.
Priyanka (Sales): one more ask: they want feedback loop for model quality - weekly sync + a shared doc for issues. I'll keep PM in loop.
Leo (CS): will set up a shared Confluence doc and weekly 30-min sync starting 1 week after pilot kick. posting updates to #customer-aerolith and will link ECC ticket.
Nina (Eng): tagging follow-up: once pool live send me perf-run commands and I'll start iterations.
Sam (Support): noted. closing initial loop; I'll update ECC ticket with network details and link this thread.
Leo (CS): thanks all  will post kickoff calendar once I have IdP metadata + infra up. :white_check_mark:
